holdersModal.title: Send creator fees to holders?
holdersModal.body: Fees are shared with token holders, weighted by amount × holding time. This option is exclusive and cannot be combined with Fee wallet or Buyback & vest.

fees.title: Simple fees, locked per token
fees.intro: Every trade pays two fees: a fixed 1% protocol fee and a 0–10% creator fee chosen at launch. Both apply on the bonding curve and after graduation, and both are locked per token.

lifecycle.title: Launch
lifecycle.body: The factory deploys SqueezToken + SqueezCurve. 1B supply is minted to the curve. Creator pays the launch fee.

lifecycle.title: Bonding curve
lifecycle.body: Buy and sell directly against the curve in HYPE. 5/7 of supply sells on the curve. Fees are taken in HYPE.

lifecycle.title: Graduation
lifecycle.body: When HYPE raised hits the threshold, the curve locks, HYPE converts to the quote asset and a Uniswap v4 pool is created.

lifecycle.title: Liquidity locked
lifecycle.body: Full-range LP + 4/49 of supply are locked forever in SqueezLiquidityLocker. There is no withdraw function.

lifecycle.title: Trading on v4
lifecycle.body: The Squeez hook takes 1% + creator fee on every swap and sends it to SqueezFeeVault.

faq.a: No. PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS = 100 is immutable in the contract.

faq.q: Can a creator change their creator fee?
faq.a: No. creatorFeeBps and the fee destination are locked at launch. Only the recipient address (feeRecipient) can be changed by the creator.

faq.q: Who can pull LP after graduation?
faq.a: Nobody, including the creator and Squeez. The locker has no withdraw function.
80% of the protocol fee goes to a keeper that buys $SQUEEZ via TWAP and burns it, to avoid MEV.
